title: Yara and the Winter
author: Edmund Yarrow
blurb: Lena Eriksen, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
